edits.text: 1. PAYMENT. The Defendant shall pay the Plaintiff USD [AMOUNT TO BE AGREED] (the “Settlement Amount”) within thirty (30) calendar days after the date on which the last party signs this Agreement (the “Effective Date”). The Settlement Amount and payment deadline remain subject to client approval and execution of a complete agreement.

2. RELEASE. Only upon Plaintiff’s receipt of the full Settlement Amount in cleared funds shall Plaintiff’s release of all claims against Defendant take effect. Execution of this Agreement alone shall not make the release effective.

3. CONFIDENTIALITY. The parties shall keep the terms of this settlement confidential, except that either party may disclose them to its legal and tax advisers or as required by law. A party disclosing terms to its advisers shall inform them of the confidential nature of those terms.
